scope: Release-candidate documentation/handoff finalization on the unchanged BuildFix12 R10 business baseline

browserRecovery.strategy: host-level coalesced recreation of DetailWebView and WorkerWebView controls
browserRecovery.queue: pause, cancel stale pending/running navigation, resume after recreation
browserRecovery.ui: show recovering state and automatically reread current subject

doDelete.mutation: Chromium Input.dispatchMouseEvent; max 2 trusted clicks in one user transaction
doDelete.listProof: 550ms grace + fresh exact do-page reload + 2 stable absent samples
doDelete.secondPass: reuse current fresh do page when 2 stable present samples remain
doDelete.detailProof: one subject-page navigation + 2 stable lightweight absent DOM samples
doDelete.redundantChecksRemoved: no final wish/collect scan on PersonalDoList route

compileFix.error: CS0157 control flow cannot leave finally clause
compileFix.strategy: set stopPumpAfterJob inside finally; return only after finally cleanup completes

autoSync.startup: render local cache first, then automatically refresh visible Douban tab
autoSync.tabChange: collect/wish/watching refresh automatically without manual click
autoSync.frontendDedupe: one automatic sync in flight per tab
autoSync.backendDedupe: WorkerJobQueue coalesces duplicate HistoryRead status/page jobs
autoSync.priority: HistoryRead stays low priority and preemptible by review read/write/delete
autoSync.recovery: auto-sync visible tab after login detection or BrowserProcessExited recovery
autoSync.manual: 立即同步豆瓣 remains as force refresh

r11.purpose: freeze current architecture, update history/status/acceptance/package docs, and prepare formal v0.9.0 release handoff
